children: Japanese stocks may remain rangebound as uncertainty over the U.S. and Japanese monetary policies continues. Nikkei futures are up 1.1% at 61490 on the SGX. The dollar is at 159.86 yen, compared with Y159.76 as of Thursday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on domestic earnings and crude oil prices. Asahi Group Holdings and Asics are set to announce their quarterly results later on Friday. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 0.7% to 60819.36 on Thursday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
